topics.description: Medicaid fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with the Trump administration deferring $91M in Medicaid funds citing fraud vulnerability. The Minnesota DHS is actively investigating Medicaid fraud in the state.
topics.reason: Increased funding and attention from law enforcement

topics.description: Non-profit organizations, such as Feeding our Future, are under scrutiny for alleged fraud. The DOJ is actively investigating Feeding our Future, and Aimee Bock, a former official, is facing sanctions.
